Manage timetable

Add or remove sessions whenever a timetable changes — no re-uploading files. Changes save instantly for everyone.

Upload your timetable PDF / PNG here

Claude reads each file (using the same double-period-CCP / single-period-Elective rule this dashboard was built on), then shows you exactly what it found so you can check it before anything is saved. This only works while this page is open inside Claude.
Their timetable is spread across more than one file? Select all the files at once — they'll be combined.
Select one file per teacher. Claude reads each teacher's name from the top of their file and matches it automatically — you can fix any it gets wrong before saving.

Found these sessions — remove any that look wrong

Saving will replace everything currently on file for this teacher with the list above. Missed a session or need to fix one? Add or tweak it afterwards from the gear icon.

Found these files — check the matched teacher for each

Saving will replace each matched teacher's timetable with the sessions found in their file. Files with no confident match are skipped unless you pick a teacher for them.
